newsitem.title: UGANDA: Uganda says to export 4.4 mln bags of coffee.
newsitem.headline: Uganda says to export 4.4 mln bags of coffee.

text.p: Uganda said on Friday it would export 4.4 million 60-kg bags of coffee in 1996/97 compared with 4.1 million bags in 1995/96 but it expected earnings to be lower.
Planning and Economic Development Minister Richard Kaijuka said in a statement that 1996/97 exports would earn Uganda $331 million compared to $441 million from 1995/96 exports.
Kaijuka made no mention of whether Uganda would still withhold some 200,000 bags of coffee under an agreement by producers.
In Febuary African robusta coffee producers agreed on how to share out an 850,000-bag cut in exports.

This followed a plan to cut world robusta exports by about one million bags, approved in January by Association of Coffee Producing Countries (ACPC) members, which groups the world's major coffee producers.
